attribution.vectors: USGS National Hydrography Dataset, US Census TIGER, Michigan DNR

bundle.description: Topo, imagery, LiDAR relief and contours, forest stands, water, roads, and the habitat, wind and going grids around Luther; full detail within 4 km of the spot.

forest.vintage: LANDFIRE 2024, NLCD 2021 (staged as the national stand layers)
forest.attribution: Forest inferred from LANDFIRE and NLCD, USGS and USFS

basemap.missing: not baked: the map draws the live NRCan base map

hillshade.missing: not baked: the map shades the relief from the DEM

dem.source: USGS 3DEP 1 arc-second, with USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, MI Lake 2016 (MI_16CountiesFEMA2015_C16) over the core

forest.source: inferred from LANDFIRE 2024, NLCD 2021 (staged as the national stand layers)
forest.vintage: LANDFIRE 2024, NLCD 2021 (staged as the national stand layers)

understory.source: Bush model (docs/BUSH-MODEL.md): the eye-level understory predicted at 30 m from Sentinel-2 seasons, PALSAR, SCANFI, CanLaD and the MRDEM, trained on 435 plots of Ontario leaf-on LiDAR; faded where the model is unsure. Modelled, not measured
understory.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data; JAXA ALOS PALSAR mosaic (free, attribution); OGL-Canada; CanLaD CC BY 4.0

lanes.source: USGS 3DEP lidar point cloud, MI_16CountiesFEMA2015_C16, flown April 2016 (leaf-off); heights above the tiles' own ground returns

bathy.missing: not baked: lake depths are drawn from GeoJSON (depth)

wmu.licence: Michigan open data (as is, no warranty)

land.source: likely private: everything outside PAD-US fee lands and Michigan DNR managed lands; closed: PAD-US lands with no public access
land.licence: public domain (US Government work); Michigan open data (as is, no warranty)

parks.source: PAD-US fee lands, USGS; DNR managed lands, Michigan DNR
parks.licence: public domain (US Government work); Michigan open data (as is, no warranty)

roads.source: USGS National Hydrography Dataset; Michigan Framework All Roads v17a (Michigan Tech), Michigan DNR roads
roads.licence: Michigan open data (as is, no warranty)

forest.missing: not in the maps as GeoJSON: the map reads the stands from the forest tiles, and the GeoJSON stays the bake's input

waterbody.source: NHDPlus High Resolution waterbodies and river areas, USGS

habitat.source: derived: MRDEM, NRCan 2020 land cover, forest stands, water, wetlands, roads and burns
habitat.note: stand height and closure from the LiDAR point cloud over 33% of the core

micro.source: derived: the habitat grid and the MRDEM

going.source: derived: HRDEM LiDAR, point-cloud bush or the forest-map estimate, water, wetlands and roads

micro-sd.source: derived: the habitat grid and the MRDEM, with the surrogate net's terrain wind in WindNinja's place (build_windsd.py)
